integrity.finite_tests: Symbolic upper-sharpness checks plus deterministic numerical checks on 144 finite networks; tests are not a replacement for proof
integrity.proof: Analytic Green-function affine-coefficient lemma, positivity of moment-product expansion, and finite exponential-sum Hessian identity

scientific_limitations: Finite time-homogeneous absorbing CTMC with positive graph-preserving rates and certain absorption
Only integer raw first-passage moments; same-source edge groups for absolute m bound, independent full-state clock factors for convexity
No bound claimed for arbitrary multiple-source groups, variance, quantiles or semi-Markov holding times
Complete 2011 Caswell full text unavailable; publication priority is qualified
title: Sharp higher-moment control bounds and convex state-clock geometry for finite passage networks
